title: Choshu’s rebellion against Fujinami
summary: Riki Choshu refuses to remain beneath Tatsumi Fujinami in New Japan’s hierarchy. His rebellion develops into a title rivalry and helps establish faction warfare between Japanese wrestlers.

chapters.title: Choshu rejects his place in the hierarchy
chapters.result: Choshu confronts Fujinami and declares his opposition.
chapters.context: The break with his senior turns an internal grievance into a rivalry that challenges the established order.

chapters.title: The rebel takes Fujinami’s title
chapters.result: Choshu defeats Fujinami by count-out for the WWF International title.
chapters.context: The challenger’s defiance now has a championship payoff, strengthening his claim to equal standing.
